name: KHAN-MD
description: A WhatsApp bot with Groq AI replies in private chats and basic commands

PHONE_NUMBER.description: WhatsApp number to request a pairing code for, with country code and digits only. Needed for first-time linking.

AUTO_REPLY.description: Enable AI replies in one-to-one chats only. Groups are ignored.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Groq API key used to generate chat replies. Keep this secret.

GROQ_MODEL.description: Groq model used for chat replies
